title: What should two to the power zero be?
description: Dividing two to the power four by itself shows what the power zero must mean, and the same idea gives five to the power zero and ten to the power zero. Keeko doubts whether no twos left means the value is zero.
teaching_notes: One idea: a power divided by itself is one, and the rule for dividing powers writes that as the power zero, so the power zero must be one. Watch for students who think no twos left means the value is zero.

source: Use 2⁴ ÷ 2⁴ to decide the value of 2 to the power 0, and then find 5 to the power 0 and 10 to the power 0.
video_script.why: A learner sees why the rule for dividing powers forces the power zero to be one.
video_script.substitution: the book's own division of two to the power four by itself, then the same idea for five and ten
video_script.anchor: two to the power four divided by itself, written as a fraction with four twos above and four below
video_script.wrong_answer: two to the power zero is zero
video_script.wrong_move: reads no twos left as a value of zero instead of one
video_script.payoff_line: A power divided by itself is one, and the rule writes that as the power zero

final_answer.value: 2 to the power 0, 5 to the power 0 and 10 to the power 0 are all 1
final_answer.spoken: two to the power zero, five to the power zero and ten to the power zero are all one

maths_rules: n^a / n^a = n^(a - a) = n^0 = 1, n is not 0
video_script.design: One idea: a power divided by itself is one, so the power zero is one. Wrong idea: no twos left means zero. Four twos above and four below cancel in pairs, and the one that is left is drawn before the rule is applied.

beats.on_screen: title card From your book; 2^4 / 2^3 = 2^1 on the left, 2^4 / 2^4 with a question mark on the right

marks.new: 2^4 / 2^4 is written beside it with a question mark over the exponent
marks.ask: a question mark glows over the new exponent

narration: <bookmark mark='book'/>This question is from your book.
<bookmark mark='known'/>Two to the power four over two to the power three takes three away from four.
<bookmark mark='new'/>Next, divide two to the power four by itself. The rule gives an exponent we have not seen yet.
<bookmark mark='ask'/>What should two to the power zero be?

beats.on_screen: the question stays on the board

marks.think: Keeko sits at the corner of the board

narration: <bookmark mark='think'/>Think and tell.

beats.on_screen: 2^4 / 2^4 as a fraction: four 2s above the bar and four 2s below it, joined in pairs

marks.above: four 2s are drawn above the bar
marks.below: four 2s are drawn below the bar
marks.pairs: each 2 above is joined to a 2 below

narration: <bookmark mark='above'/>Write two to the power four as a fraction over itself.
<bookmark mark='below'/>There are four twos above the bar and four twos below it.
<bookmark mark='pairs'/>Every two above can cancel with a two below.
<bookmark mark='given'/>Given, two to the power four divided by two to the power four.

marks.find: the words 2^0, then 5^0 and 10^0 are written

narration: <bookmark mark='find'/>We have to find two to the power zero. We also need five and ten to the power zero.
<bookmark mark='nums'/>Step one, work out the division with numbers. Two to the power four is sixteen, so we divide sixteen by sixteen.
<bookmark mark='one'/>A number divided by itself is one. All four twos cancel, and one is left.

marks.rule: 2^(4 - 4) appears from the rule for dividing powers

narration: <bookmark mark='rule'/>Step two, use the rule for dividing powers, which takes the exponents away.
<bookmark mark='zero'/>Four take away four is zero, so the same division gives two to the power zero.

beats.on_screen: the same division gave 1 and 2^0, so 2^0 must be 1

marks.same: 1 and 2^0 are joined by an equals sign

narration: <bookmark mark='same'/>Step three, put the two results together. One division cannot have two different values.
<bookmark mark='must'/>Two to the power zero must be one.
<bookmark mark='five'/>Step four, repeat the idea. Five cubed divided by five cubed is one, and the rule gives five to the power zero.
<bookmark mark='ten'/>In the same way, ten to the power zero is one.

marks.pay: a power divided by itself is 1, and the power 0 is boxed

narration: <bookmark mark='pay'/>A power divided by itself is one, and the rule writes that as the power zero.
<bookmark mark='ans'/>Two to the power zero is one. Five to the power zero and ten to the power zero are also one.
<bookmark mark='hand'/>Keeko has raised a hand. Let us check the doubt and solve it.

beats.on_screen: Keeko's bubble: 2^0 = 0, no 2s left, struck out; 16 / 16 = 1 beside it

marks.doubt: Keeko's bubble shows 2^0 = 0 with no 2s left

narration: <bookmark mark='doubt'/>Keeko thinks two to the power zero is zero, because no twos are left.
<bookmark mark='fix'/>But sixteen divided by sixteen is one, not zero. Cancelling twos never takes the whole value away.
<bookmark mark='all'/>When every two cancels, a one is left behind.
